test_title: PYST 6: SSC GD Constable 2025 - English (Held On: 05 Feb, 2025 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank and make the sentence meaningful.

You must refrain __________ unpleasant conversations.
solution:
The correct answer is '**from**'. 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 
 
 
• The correct preposition to use in this sentence is "**from**" as it indicates avoidance or abstaining from something. 
 
• The word "refrain" is often followed by the preposition "from" when talking about abstaining from an action or behavior.
